items.title: From Working Group to SIG Architecture: spotlight on AI Conformance
items.blurb: In this SIG Architecture spotlight we talked with Janet Kuo (Google) and Yuan Tang (TensorScale AI) about the journey of AI Conformance in Kubernetes, from the initial Working Group to the integration SIG Architecture as a subproject.

items.title: Announcing the Workload Conformance Working Group
items.blurb: We are excited to announce that the Kubernetes community now has a Workload Conformance Working Group . The working group is writing a shared standard for how workloads behave at runtime on Kubernetes.

items.title: Kubernetes Confidential Containers Get Fortanix Attestation and Key Management
items.blurb: Fortanix's CoCo integration connects workload attestation to decryption-key release for Kubernetes AI workloads.

items.title: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
items.blurb: You submit a Kubernetes Job and wait for its Pods to appear. A minute passes. Then another. The Job is still suspended, there are no application logs, and there may not even be a Pod to inspect.

items.title: Readyon Builds Four Layer Tenant Isolation for Multi Tenant Amazon EKS
items.blurb: ReadyOn has detailed a four-layer tenant isolation architecture for its Harmony platform on Amazon EKS.

items.title: The Shift to cgroup v2 in Kubernetes: What You Need to Know
items.blurb: In Linux, cgroups (control groups) are a kernel feature used for managing system resources.
